c243bb55-92f9-4f77-bb2a-b7c87b5a2be9.title: Stable Energy Anchor
c243bb55-92f9-4f77-bb2a-b7c87b5a2be9.description: A stable energy anchor pulled from the zone. Powers the ARC Device, and the Fabricator takes it as payment: carry it there and click to deposit.

a6be2c12-f280-4d2b-b270-8e407813c28d.description: Holds an energy anchor in the zone.
a6be2c12-f280-4d2b-b270-8e407813c28d.title: Anchor Pedestal

a6258a75-ea2b-47f7-acec-a3ace313bbd9.title: ARC Device
a6258a75-ea2b-47f7-acec-a3ace313bbd9.description: Mount it on your car. Carry energy anchors to it and click to insert, then wire a button or switch to it to open a gateway out of the zone.

e3473813-1984-4a22-9ef7-b1b9f735ccbf.title: Fuel Pump
e3473813-1984-4a22-9ef7-b1b9f735ccbf.description: Gas for the car: 20 canisters every time you're back at the garage. Needs garage power.

7ee97af5-72b9-4335-a3bd-e80d49dab105.title: Fabricator
7ee97af5-72b9-4335-a3bd-e80d49dab105.description: Place it in the garage. Spend component kits on upgrades to unlock new schematics for the Craftbot.

e7a1c3d2-5b6f-4a8e-9c1d-2f3b4a5c6d7e.title: Unstable Energy Anchor
e7a1c3d2-5b6f-4a8e-9c1d-2f3b4a5c6d7e.description: An unstable energy anchor from deeper in the zone. Powers the ARC Device like any anchor; the Fabricator takes it for better upgrades.

9b8c7d6e-1f2a-4b3c-8d4e-5f6a7b8c9d0e.title: Corrupted Energy Anchor
9b8c7d6e-1f2a-4b3c-8d4e-5f6a7b8c9d0e.description: A corrupted energy anchor from the deepest junctions. Powers the ARC Device like any anchor; the Fabricator takes it for its best upgrades.

d0f1e2a3-b4c5-4d6e-8f70-81a2b3c4d5e6.title: Friendly Dumpster
d0f1e2a3-b4c5-4d6e-8f70-81a2b3c4d5e6.description: It refills after every trip into the zone. Open it for free supplies.

c1d2e3f4-a5b6-4c7d-8e9f-a0b1c2d3e4f5.title: Route Planner
c1d2e3f4-a5b6-4c7d-8e9f-a0b1c2d3e4f5.description: Plan your trips into the zone: scan junctions, re-stabilize them and set a destination.

7de73157-8f20-4fe6-9514-299fc166aaf7.title: Supply Pod
7de73157-8f20-4fe6-9514-299fc166aaf7.description: Comes down while the zone collapses. Rarer supplies inside.

e49b210a-0d46-4f06-bcd8-08862379d156.title: Mid Zone Key
e49b210a-0d46-4f06-bcd8-08862379d156.description: The farmers' key to the Mid Zone, for the food you brought them. Hold on to it: the junctions beyond the Outer Zone are open to you now.
